 Openloop\-Health is at the forefront of developing advanced healthcare infrastructure powered by artificial intelligence. We are seeking talented and experienced professionals to join our team at the Senior, Staff, and Senior Staff levels. The role involves designing, building, and maintaining AI\-driven systems that support real\-world healthcare applications. Candidates will be responsible for developing robust large language model (LLM)\-based agents, orchestrating their runtime environments, ensuring system evaluation and improvement, and maintaining operational excellence. We value expertise in AI engineering, system architecture, and security, and are looking for individuals who can contribute to our mission of delivering reliable, safe, and effective virtual healthcare solutions. During the recruitment process, we will assess your level based on your scope of work and depth of experience, rather than solely on years of service.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Proven engineering experience with 5 to 15\+ years in software development, with a focus on production systems.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating large language model (LLM)\-based systems in production environments relied upon by real users, typically 2\+ years for senior staff candidates.
* Deep expertise in at least one core AI area such as agent runtime, evaluation, retrieval, or observability and cost management. Senior Staff candidates should demonstrate depth in agent runtime or evaluation, along with working knowledge across other areas.
* Experience in rigorous evaluation methodologies, including creating evaluation sets, test harnesses, and regression testing to quantify system improvements.
* Strong foundation in production engineering practices, including testing, debugging, API development, deployment, and on\-call support.
* Experience handling sensitive data with a security\-first mindset, ensuring compliance with data privacy standards.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working in a greenfield environment, demonstrating adaptability and initiative.


**Responsibilities**
* Build and deploy reliable LLM\-based agents and assistants that end\-users depend on for daily operations, moving beyond prototypes to production\-ready systems.
* Design and implement agent runtime environments, including tool calling, context management, failure handling, retries, timeouts, and sandboxing to ensure robustness and scalability.
* Create evaluation frameworks, test harnesses, and monitoring tools to continuously assess system performance and identify regressions before impacting users.
* Manage access to multiple AI model providers, oversee version upgrades, and develop fallback strategies to maintain system stability during provider failures.
* Implement observability solutions to trace AI agent actions, monitor behavior in production, and attribute costs accurately to different use cases.
